title: CreateResult
description: Result of `rebar create … --output json` (and the library create_ticket(return_alias=True) / MCP create_ticket): {id, alias, title}. The default text form prints a human summary line then the bare id (| tail -1). `description_warning` is the advisory save-time notice when the new description exceeds `verify.max_ticket_description_chars` while the plan-review start-work gate is enabled (null otherwise); `duplicate_warning` is the advisory create-time notice when another create inside the recency window carries the same normalized title while `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` is enabled (null otherwise). Both are carried on the library and MCP results — the CLI emits them on stderr instead, keeping stdout pure in both output modes.
